collapse.judged_as: dragged into the field or not

scoring.order: both orders; a flipped verdict is a tie
scoring.taste_ab: log-probability forced choice, both orders, no judge

blocks.new_work: held-out source item with every probe derived from it
blocks.taste_ab: held-out source item; a shared item is one block across both matched-pair lives, resampled jointly

win.life_ahead_when: its own tie-inclusive score is above 0.50
win.single_life_vs_3x: field check: reported, never needed for a claim row
win.unpromoted_donor: counts as not ahead on 3 vs 3x and is left out of the pooled 3x score and CI; stated as inconclusive

loss: the same rule in the other direction

fairness.win_or_loss: same rule as win and loss above
fairness.matches: CI lower bound above the margin, without a win; at or below the margin is never called a match

claim_table.applied: to each dimension separately; the first matching row wins

rows.when: 3 wins against both 1 and 3x, and both matched-pair lives are ahead against 3x
rows.claim: With every note removed, her own weights [know her world / talk her way] better than the base model, and better than another person's trained weights, on 3 lives drawn after the code froze.

rows.when: 3 wins against 1; against 3x it is inconclusive or a loss
rows.claim: With every note removed, sleep made her weights better than the base model at [her kind of work / the way she wants to be talked to]. Against another person's trained weights it was [inconclusive / a loss], so we don't claim it learned her in particular.
A week of nightly training didn't make her weights measurably better [in knowledge / in interaction] without notes. Here is exactly what we measured.

qualifiers.when: a knowledge win did not survive style-neutral re-judging
qualifiers.claim: once style was flattened, the result was [win / inconclusive / loss], so we don't claim it's substance

qualifiers.when: a comparison the Gemini judge scored as a loss
qualifiers.claim: a second judge from another model family disagreed, with both numbers
the measured cost per person per month at the registered configuration; over the ceiling the wording is: her weights learned, but not yet at a viable cost ($X a month)
4 against 2C and 4 against 2F on new_work, each as win, loss, inconclusive or matches, beside 2F's prompt length and cost per turn
